#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""User-approved same-campaign paired compilation; frozen source is never edited."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,datetime,fcntl,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,threading,time
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('project',type=Path);p.add_argument('--expected-source-sha256',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
root=a.project.resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from release_support import source_manifest,module_inventory,imports,sha256,dump_json
out=root/'.verification-results';lock=(out/'campaign-continuation.lock').open('a+')
try:fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
except BlockingIOError:raise SystemExit('Previous owner still holds campaign lock; refusing overlap.')
frozen=json.loads((out/'source-manifest.json').read_text())
assert frozen['project_source_sha256']==a.expected_source_sha256 and source_manifest(root)==frozen
report=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());assert not report['passed']
prior=json.loads((out/'module-build-timings.json').read_text());inv=module_inventory(root)
completed=[]
for record in prior:
    if record['exit_code']:break
    completed.append(record['module'])
assert completed==inv['topological_modules'][:len(completed)]
for name in ('report.json','module-build-timings.json','all-modules.log','continuation-provenance.json'):
    target=out/('pre-parallel-'+name)
    assert not target.exists(),'Existing parallel checkpoint requires inspection'
    shutil.copy2(out/name,target)
objects=root/'.lake/build/lib/lean';retained=[]
for module in completed:
    file=objects/Path(*module.split('.')).with_suffix('.olean')
    assert file.is_file() and not file.is_symlink() and file.resolve().is_relative_to(root)
    retained.append({'module':module,'path':file.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':sha256(file.read_bytes())})
done=set(completed);remaining=set(inv['modules'])-done;quarantined=[]
# An interrupted compiler may have left outputs without a successful checkpoint.
for module in sorted(remaining):
    rel=Path(*module.split('.'))
    for base in (root/'.lake/build/lib/lean',root/'.lake/build/ir'):
        path=base/rel
        if not path.parent.exists():continue
        for file in sorted(path.parent.glob(path.name+'.*')):
            if not file.is_file():continue
            target=out/'unconfirmed-output-quarantine'/file.relative_to(root/'.lake/build')
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            quarantined.append({'path':file.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':sha256(file.read_bytes())})
            shutil.move(file,target)
runner=Path(__file__).read_bytes()
proof={'schema_version':1,'event':'user-approved-bounded-scheduling-change',
       'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
       'source_sha256':frozen['project_source_sha256'],'source_matches_before':True,
       'exclusive_owner_lock_acquired':True,'previous_owner_session_terminal_confirmed':True,
       'authorization':'Coordinator confirmed explicit user approval of bounded parallel execution and an owner-controlled interruption/handoff.',
       'old_policy':report['build_policy'],
       'new_policy':{'coordinators':1,'maximum_new_project_modules_per_batch':2,'lean_threads_per_compiler':2,
                     'dependency_preflight':'lake --no-build --wfail build +A:deps +B:deps',
                     'final_validation':'All seven original gates, with the unchanged sequential all-module script and one Lean thread'},
       'retained_same_campaign_artifacts':retained,'quarantined_unconfirmed_outputs':quarantined,
       'externally_built_project_artifacts_imported':False,
       'runner_source_utf8':runner.decode(),'runner_source_sha256':sha256(runner),
       'commands':[],'status':'running'}
report['scheduling_change_provenance']='parallel-scheduling-provenance.json'
report['build_policy_history']=[report['build_policy'],proof['new_policy']]
report['build_policy']={'project_modules':'same-campaign dependency-ready pairs; final unchanged sequential validation',
                      'maximum_new_project_compilers':2,'pair_phase_lean_threads':2,'final_gate_lean_threads':1}
report['checks']=[];report['passed']=False;report['whole_paper_release_gate_passed']=False
dump_json(out/'report.json',report);dump_json(out/'parallel-scheduling-provenance.json',proof)

def run(name,command,threads=2,gate=False):
    print(f'[{name}] {command}',flush=True);begin=time.monotonic()
    item={'name':name,'command':command,'lean_num_threads':threads,'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    proof['commands'].append(item);dump_json(out/'parallel-scheduling-provenance.json',proof)
    samples=[];stop=threading.Event()
    def monitor():
        while not stop.wait(1):
            rows=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-eo','comm=,rss=,args='],text=True).splitlines()
            lean=[]
            for row in rows:
                cols=row.strip().split(None,2)
                if len(cols)==3 and cols[0]=='lean' and 'UploadBroadcast' in cols[2]:lean.append(int(cols[1]))
            mem={s.split(':')[0]:s.split(':')[1].strip() for s in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if ':' in s}
            samples.append({'project_lean_processes':len(lean),'combined_rss_kib':sum(lean),'available_memory_kib':int(mem['MemAvailable'].split()[0])})
    path=out/('parallel-'+name+'.log')
    with path.open('w') as log:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(['bash','-c','set -euo pipefail; source scripts/env.sh; '+command],cwd=root,
             env=dict(os.environ,LEAN_NUM_THREADS=str(threads),PAPER_RELEASE_THREADS=str(threads)),
             stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,pass_fds=(lock.fileno(),))
        watcher=threading.Thread(target=monitor,daemon=True);watcher.start()
        try:
            for line in proc.stdout:print(line,end='',flush=True);log.write(line);log.flush()
            code=proc.wait()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            proc.terminate();proc.wait();code=130
        finally:stop.set();watcher.join(timeout=3)
    item.update({'exit_code':code,'duration_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-begin,3),'log':path.name})
    if samples:
        item['resource_observations']={'max_project_lean_processes':max(s['project_lean_processes'] for s in samples),
           'peak_combined_project_rss_kib':max(s['combined_rss_kib'] for s in samples),
           'minimum_available_memory_kib':min(s['available_memory_kib'] for s in samples)}
        assert item['resource_observations']['max_project_lean_processes']<=2,'Unexpected additional project compiler'
    if gate:report['checks'].append({'name':name,'command':command,'exit_code':code,'duration_seconds':item['duration_seconds'],'log':path.name})
    dump_json(out/'parallel-scheduling-provenance.json',proof);dump_json(out/'report.json',report)
    if code:
        proof['status']='failed';dump_json(out/'parallel-scheduling-provenance.json',proof)
        raise SystemExit(code)

all_modules=set(inv['modules']);deps={m:set(imports(root/Path(*m.split('.')).with_suffix('.lean')))&all_modules for m in all_modules}
index=0
while remaining:
    ready=[m for m in inv['topological_modules'] if m in remaining and deps[m]<=done]
    assert ready,'No dependency-ready module in remaining graph'
    batch=ready[:2];index+=1
    print(f'PAIRED BATCH {index}: {len(done)}/{len(all_modules)} complete; {batch}',flush=True)
    run(f'batch-{index:03d}-dependencies','lake --no-build --wfail build '+' '.join('+'+m+':deps' for m in batch))
    run(f'batch-{index:03d}-build','lake --wfail build '+' '.join('+'+m for m in batch))
    artifacts=[]
    for module in batch:
        file=objects/Path(*module.split('.')).with_suffix('.olean');assert file.is_file()
        artifacts.append({'module':module,'sha256':sha256(file.read_bytes())})
    done.update(batch);remaining.difference_update(batch)
    proof['completed_project_module_count']=len(done)
    proof.setdefault('completed_batches',[]).append({'batch':batch,'artifacts':artifacts})
    dump_json(out/'parallel-scheduling-provenance.json',proof)
checks=[('toolchain','python3 scripts/verify_toolchain.py --output .verification-results/toolchain.json'),
 ('dependency-pins','python3 scripts/verify_dependency_pins.py --output .verification-results/dependency-pins.json'),
 ('release-regressions','python3 scripts/test_release_tools.py && python3 scripts/test_audit_source.py && python3 scripts/test_package_release.py'),
 ('source-preflight','python3 scripts/audit_source.py && python3 scripts/check_coverage.py'),
 ('all-modules','python3 scripts/check_all_modules.py'),('integrated-check','bash scripts/check.sh'),
 ('complete-coverage','python3 scripts/check_coverage.py')]
for name,command in checks:run(name,command,threads=1,gate=True)
unchanged=source_manifest(root)==frozen
report['source_unchanged_during_checks']=unchanged;report['finished_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
report['passed']=unchanged;report['whole_paper_release_gate_passed']=unchanged
proof['source_matches_after']=unchanged;proof['status']='passed' if unchanged else 'source-changed';proof['finished_utc']=report['finished_utc']
dump_json(out/'parallel-scheduling-provenance.json',proof);dump_json(out/'report.json',report)
if not unchanged:raise SystemExit('Frozen source changed; refusing release')
print('Same frozen clean-start campaign completed; every original gate passed after bounded parallel prebuilds.',flush=True)
